messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager - Canary health alert for model 'synth-io' (v2.3) in eu-west-1. Error rate spike + tokenizer-parse-errors. Auto-fallback to v2.2 engaged for 18% of traffic. Paging oncall.

sam: oncall, saw it. I'm marking P1 and joining. What customer impact?

olivia: seeing lots of tokenization mismatch logs on the canary hosts: 'TokenizerVocabMismatch: expected size 5020, got 502'. That explains garbled outputs. Also some responses truncated mid-sentence.

zach-eng: digging into deploy metadata - the artifact uploaded with tag v2.3 was built against tokenizers/v1.1 while the deploy config referenced tokenizers/v1.0. Looks like an automated artifact promotion used the wrong label. Weightset hash in metadata doesn't match the runtime manifest.

eli: paging infra - the rollout policy had burst routing enabled -> canary ramped to 20% due to traffic spike rule. We should flip that rule and stop any further increases.

sam: ok, immediate controls: 1) flip feature-flag route_to_v2 to false, 2) abort the rollout and route all traffic back to v2.2, 3) notify support. Who can flip the flag? @deploy-bot / @oncall-ops?

oncall-ops: I can do the flag flip now. Running command to set flag off:
```
# ops console
redwood feature-toggle set --org=redwood --flag=route_to_v2 --value=false
```
Doing it now.

deploy-bot: Feature toggle route_to_v2 set to false by oncall-ops. Confirmed: no new canary traffic will be routed. :white_check_mark:

maria-support: Support sees a handful of customer complaints about strange completions and truncated responses. Triage: 12 unique customers, 4 enterprise tenants with higher severity. Notifying account teams.

zach-eng: initiating abort/rollback. Running rollout abort and explicit weight pin to v2.2:
```
# rollback command
redwood rollout abort --model=synth-io --tag=v2.3 --reason="tokenizer/weights mismatch"
redwood weights pin --model=synth-io --weightset=v2.2
```
Logs show abort accepted.

eli: restarting canary pods after weight pin to ensure no leftover kv-cache mismatch: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/synth-io-canary`. Also clearing KV cache on canaries: `/opt/redwood/bin/kvcache flush --model=synth-io --hosts=canary`

olivia: double-checking tokenizers on artifact storage. Found that the v2.3 artifact references tokenizer bundle id: tk-20260301-xyz which is missing expected vocab file. Looks like a CI job that prunes tokenizer artifacts ran between build and promotion.

sam: good catch. For immediate mitigation, we've pinned runtime to v2.2 and stopped routing. Next step: re-build v2.3 candidate with correct tokenizer bundle and run an isolated canary with 0.5% traffic. No re-promotion until we have manual signoff.

maria-support: informing affected customers: sending templated message to 12 customers now, note: degraded completions, rollback to previous model, workaround - increase temperature? (not ideal). Requesting list of queries that returned bad outputs for validation.

zach-eng: I pushed a temp label to artifact registry to mark suspect v2.3 as quarantined: `art-reg tag synth-io:v2.3 suspect/quarantine`

deploy-bot: Rollout abort completed at 3812345820. Traffic baseline restored to v2.2 for all routes.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress - feature flag flipped, rollout aborted, KV caches cleared, canary pods restarted. Pager cleared for oncall but monitoring for regression.

eli: monitoring: 502 errors dropped back to baseline, tokenizer errors gone on prod nodes, canary hosts still report a few parse errors but show 0 after restart.

sam: assigning postmortem and owner: zach-eng to lead root-cause. Actions: (A) permanent fix for CI artifact pruning race, (B) add verification job to ensure tokenizer bundle presence before promotion, (C) change canary ramp to manual for model weight promotions, (D) customer outreach follow-up.

zach-eng: will own RCA and follow-ups. ETA for draft postmortem 48h.

maria-support: I'll collate customer reports and attach examples to the incident ticket. Escalating the 4 enterprise customers to SEs now.

olivia: note for the postmortem: add reproduction steps and the specific commit that produced the bad artifact (ci-job/3421). Also recommend a checksum verification step in the promotion pipeline.

sam: closing notes: severity P1 -> downgraded to P2 after rollback and customer mitigations. If anything resurfaces ping this thread. Good run everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated at 3812345978. Follow-ups tracked in ticket #INC-2026-341.
